summary: Reduce observation spool writes without weakening crash durability

replay.detail: Pending events retain ordered durable replay and acknowledgement semantics.

schema.detail: Observation SQLite schema and storage version are unchanged.

rules.detail: Ownership fences, FULL synchronization and WAL automatic checkpointing are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Identical snapshot reports do not enqueue redundant events. Timeline physical retention allows 256 rows or 128 KiB of slack before batch pruning; readers retain the 4096-row, 2 MiB window. Short-lived connections defer last-close checkpoints while the existing WAL is below a 1000-page byte budget; at or above it, SQLite's ordinary last-close checkpoint is enabled. Subagent ledger change detection and atomic replacement remain unchanged.

manual.detail: No configuration or store migration required.

recovery.detail: Existing binaries can read the unchanged SQLite format.
